title: Page 3
content_zh:
「这儿有两个活口！」

不待野风反抗，一股庞大的威压已袭至她的面前，让只是军级高阶的她当下晕死过去。

待到她再睁开双眼时，她已身处在一辆挤满人的牛车上，脖子上套上了粗绳，双手也被绑缚在身后，而奶娘张婶，则是倒在她的脚边犹未醒来。她试着运起内力检查了一下身子，发现自个儿的经脉虽有受损却无大碍，这让她松了口气，这才有空抬眼打量一下自个儿眼下所身处的情况。

不大的牛车上，挤满了老弱妇孺，有些或受伤犹未醒来，有些则是受惊过度低低啜泣着，而在牛车的两旁，则有两名看上去像是武者的男子骑在马匹上看押着他们。

载运着他们的牛车在走过偏僻的官道来到了山道时，便无法再往前行了，前头驾着牛车的男子便弃了车，将他们一众人都拖下车，拖着他们颈上的粗绳，像是拖拉着牲畜般拉着他们走上崎岖的山道。

携着雪花的海风，越过了群山来到了萧瑟的山林间，一阵冰凉的寒意扑上野风的脸庞，她疲惫地抬起头，发现在连走了数日后，他们已来到了县城处的附近。随着沿路上山林的风景渐渐消失，一间间坐落在田地里的民房开始出现，而后又再次踏上官道时，她发现，眼前这座她曾熟悉的县城，已不再是她记忆中的模样。

以往繁华的县城，原本整洁的街道早已不再，犹在燃烧的民宅所冒出的黑烟熏黑了墙面，街上四处可见被弃的马车残损的车架或是家当，遭到众多流民洗劫过的县城，此时已换上了哀戚的面容。一路上，一批批似他们这些人一样如囚犯被押进城的百姓，个个垂首丧气或失魂落魄地拖着脚步往城心走去。

当县衙已然在望，野风焦急地抬首左顾右看，却没见着那些原本该护卫在县衙前的士兵，只见着了一群面生的武者，她忍不住出声问向一群刚由县衙里拖出来的人。

「太守人呢？太守夫妻他们现下在哪？」这是怎么回事？身为太守的爹爹不是应该坐镇在这儿指挥吗？怎么四下半个官兵都没见着不说，四处还有一些实力高强的武者看哨？

「太守？」其中一名男子闻言抬起头，示意她看向一旁，「不就在那？」野风随着他的指示看去，就在县衙大门不远处的围墙上，双亲的身影如断线的人偶高挂在上头，她怔怔地瞠大了眼，哆嗦着身子刚想开口呼喊爹娘，走在她身后的张婶已偏过身子重重朝她一撞，令她狠狠扑跌在地。地上尖锐的石磕在她额头上，带来火辣的灼痛与片刻的清醒，那疼痛是那么的真实与残忍，令她深深倒抽了口气。

她还来不及咀嚼半点悲伤，就已被路旁的武者提起衣领，并在她身后踢了一脚要她继续往前走，脑袋犹空茫一片的她两脚都没来得及站稳，就又冷不防地再跌回地上，这一回，石砾狠狠划过她的面颊，令她的半张脸都染上了血污。

在她迟迟未起身，令那位武者十分不满又想再添上一脚时，张婶已扑至她的身后。

「大人、大人……我家孩子生来体弱，您行行好，就饶了她吧……」张婶边求情边用脚踢着野风，「愣着做什么？还不站起来快走？」随着颈间系着的粗绳的拉扯与身后张婶的推搡，野风摇摇晃晃地站起，重新回到列队中继续往前走，她在县衙内茫然地听着张婶向主事的人编造她俩的新身分，而后再被押至一座新盖好的大牢内。

长期的劳顿与过度的悲伤，打击着她这副幼小的躯体，才抵达牢内她便一头栽倒，身子滚烫得吓人，张婶两眼含泪地将她拖抱至怀中，怎么也不肯松手。

第1章(2)

「奶娘……」野风困顿地睁开眼。

张婶将下颔贴在她的额际，沙哑地道：「今后，就剩咱们俩了……」关入牢中数日后，听着外头断断续续传来的消息，不只是野风与奶娘，牢中的所有人，都为所打探到的消息无一不感到胆寒。

原来那些武者，他们并不是人，又或者该说，他们曾经是人，只是现下有了个新名称叫做魂役，他们都是由那位占领了县城的孟参军许愿许出来的，而孟参军之所以养着他们，是因为，他们是用来许愿的「材料」。

拥有魂纸的人都知道，许愿，是必须付出代价的。可想当魂主的人从没人想牺牲自身什么，更不舍得自身遭受什么伤害，于是他们便把主意打在他人的身上。

于是满城的百姓，与流离至此地的流民们，便成了用来许愿的免费材料。

经过数回尝试，孟参军发现用来许愿的材料，以年轻力壮的男子最佳，老弱妇孺最劣。杀了十来个男子作为代价所许出的魂役，不过就是个士级初阶的武士而已，杀了百来个男子许出的魂役，竟侥幸是个士级中阶，以此类推，倘若用上千条性命，那么，是不是就可以许出个一心只忠于自己的士级高阶武士？

若是用上了万条人命，是不是就能许出梦寐以求的相级高手，而在有了相级高手之后，来日要想在这乱世开疆扩土更上一层楼，则将不再是个幻梦？

于是在短短数月内，县城中的民宅寺庙等建筑一一被拆毁，腾出来的土地，在孟参军的令下，纷纷改建起一座座大型的牢房，用来关养着日后将会派上用场的许愿材料。一旦关着的材料用尽了，孟参军便大举派出旗下所有的魂役，攻向邻镇邻县任何有活口的地方，大举搜刮百姓充入牢中，以作为下一波的许愿材料。

春去秋来，县城里的十座大牢，空了又满，满了又空，唯一人数没有大变动的，就只有关着老弱妇孺的那座大牢。因这等材料的实用性不高，许出来的魂役大多为普通百姓，故而孟参军也就挪开了目光没将他们派用上场，但他们也没被白养着，全数充为孟家家奴，平时白日里就让他们在孟府中做事，夜了就再将他们关回牢中。

两年的时光过去，野风的身分自太守千金摇身一变，成为了孟府别院倒夜香的小厮，成日与脏臭辛苦为伍，到了夜里回到牢中，她也没工夫闲着。

上了年纪的张婶，打从进了吃不饱穿不暖的大牢后，身子骨便一日不比一日，在野风求了牢头看守后，便一直都在牢中歇息养病。只是众人皆不知，那个成日躺在两人牢房中的张婶，白日里在众人离牢去上工时，她便躺在墙边以银簪挖墙洞，待到野风晚上回牢后，再由野风接手细细续挖，这一挖，便持续了两年，而两年的时光，也终于让她俩挖出了个希望。

直至张婶病重，而她们身上用来贿赂牢头的银两也已用尽，眼看着张婶这病再不用药恐有危险，野风放弃了再多挖一段时日，好让牢洞大点两人可一块儿逃出去的想法，趁着夜深人静时分，她服侍张婶睡下后，便悄悄钻出了那仅可容她这孩子通过的小洞，摸黑溜进了以往是太守旧居现下却是孟府的别院，一路摸进药房里头，想找些可用的药。

天色将明时分，收获不丰的野风怀里揣着几块老姜与几根蔘须，偷偷攀上负责运送夜香的牛车混出别院，只是车行不过一会儿便在大街上被拦下，丛丛火把四下高举，大街明亮如昼，接着便是整齐的军队行伍之声由远至近。
content_en:
"There are two alive here!"

Before Yefeng could resist, a huge coercion hit her, causing her, who was only a high-ranking military officer, to faint immediately.

When she opened her eyes again, she was already in a bullock cart full of people, with a thick rope around her neck and her hands tied behind her. Aunt Zhang, the wet nurse, fell at her feet and still didn't wake up.She tried to summon up her internal strength to check her body, and found that although her meridians were damaged, they were not seriously injured. This made her sigh in relief, and then she had time to raise her eyes to take stock of the situation she was currently in.

The small bullock cart was crowded with old, weak, women and children. Some were injured and still hadn't woken up, while others were frightened and sobbing softly. On both sides of the bullock cart, there were two men who looked like warriors on horses watching over them.

When the ox cart carrying them walked through the remote official road and reached the mountain road, it could no longer go forward. The man driving the ox cart in front abandoned the cart and dragged them all out of the car. He dragged the thick ropes around their necks and dragged them up the rugged mountain road like animals.

The sea breeze carrying snowflakes crossed the mountains and arrived in the bleak forest. A cold chill hit Ye Feng's face. She raised her head tiredly and found that after walking for several days, they had arrived near the county seat.As the scenery of the mountains and forests along the road gradually disappeared, private houses located in the fields began to appear. Then when she set foot on the official road again, she found that the county town she was familiar with was no longer what she remembered.

In the bustling county town in the past, the original neat streets were no longer there. The black smoke from the burning houses blackened the walls. Abandoned carriages, damaged frames or belongings could be seen everywhere on the streets. The county town, which had been looted by many refugees, now had a sad look on its face.Along the way, groups of people like them were escorted into the city like prisoners, all of them dragging their feet towards the center of the city with their heads down or in despair.

When the county government was already in sight, Yefeng looked up anxiously and looked around, but she didn't see the soldiers who were supposed to be guarding the county government. She only saw a group of unfamiliar warriors. She couldn't help but ask a group of people who had just been dragged out of the county government.

"Where are the prefects? Where are the prefect and his wife?" What's going on?As a prefect, shouldn’t dad sit here and give orders?Why are there not even a few officers and soldiers around to see and say anything, but there are still some powerful warriors standing guard everywhere?

"Prefect?" One of the men raised his head when he heard this and motioned her to look aside, "Isn't it right there?" Yefeng followed his instructions and saw that on the wall not far from the county government gate, the figures of her parents were likeThe broken doll hung high on top. She stared blankly, trembling and just about to call her parents, Aunt Zhang, who was walking behind her, turned and bumped into her hard, causing her to fall to the ground.The sharp stone on the ground hit her forehead, causing burning pain and a moment of clarity. The pain was so real and cruel that she took a deep breath.

Before she could even chew on her sorrow, a warrior on the roadside picked up her collar and kicked her behind her to keep going forward. Her head was still blank and she didn't have time to stand firm on her feet, so she fell back to the ground unexpectedly. This time, the gravel scratched her cheek hard, leaving half of her face stained with blood.

When she didn't stand up for a long time, which made the warrior very dissatisfied and wanted to add another kick, Aunt Zhang had already rushed behind her.

"My lord, my lord... my child was born weak. Please be kind and spare her..." Aunt Zhang begged while kicking Ye Feng with her feet. "What are you doing standing still? Why don't you stand up and walk quickly?" As the thick rope tied around her neck was pulled andPushed by Aunt Zhang behind her, Yefeng stood up unsteadily, returned to the queue and continued walking forward. She listened blankly in the county office as Aunt Zhang fabricated their new identities to the person in charge, and then was taken to a newly built prison.

The long-term fatigue and excessive sadness hit her young body, and she fell down as soon as she reached the prison. Her body was frighteningly hot. Aunt Zhang dragged her into her arms with tears in her eyes and refused to let go.

Chapter 1(2)

"Nanny..." Nofeng opened his eyes in confusion.

Aunt Zhang put her chin on her forehead and said hoarsely: "From now on, the two of us are the only ones left..." After being imprisoned for several days, listening to the news coming intermittently from outside, not only Yefeng and the wet nurse, but everyone in the prison felt frightened by the news they found out.

It turns out that those warriors are not human beings, or rather, they used to be human beings, but now they have a new name called soul service. They were all made by Meng Canjun who occupied the county. The reason why Meng Canjun raised them was because they were the "materials" used to make wishes.

Anyone who owns a soul paper knows that making a wish requires paying a price.But no one who wants to be a soul master wants to sacrifice themselves, let alone suffer any harm to themselves, so they set their sights on others.

So the people all over the city and the refugees who lived here became free materials for making wishes.

After several attempts, Meng Canjun found that young and strong men were the best materials for making wishes, while old, weak, women and children were the worst.The soul service promised in exchange for killing a dozen men was just for a junior warrior. The soul service promised after killing a hundred men was lucky enough to be for an intermediate warrior. By analogy, if thousands of lives are used, then can a high-level warrior be loyal to himself?

If tens of thousands of human lives were used, would it be possible to produce the coveted prime ministers? After having prime ministers, it would no longer be a fantasy to expand the territory in this troubled world and reach a higher level in the future?

So in just a few months, the houses, temples and other buildings in the county were demolished one by one, and the vacated land was converted into large cells under Meng Canjun's order to store the wishing materials that would be used in the future.Once the imprisoned materials were exhausted, Meng Shenjun sent out all the soul servants under his banner to attack any place where there was a living person in the neighboring towns and counties, and plundered the people and put them in prison as the next wave of wish-making materials.

As spring passed and autumn came, the ten prisons in the county became empty and full, full and empty again. The only one whose population did not change significantly was the prison where the old, weak, women and children were imprisoned.Due to the low practicality of such materials, most of the soul slaves promised were ordinary people, so Meng Shenjun averted his eyes and did not send them to work. However, they were not kept in vain. They were all used as slaves of the Meng family. They were allowed to work in the Meng Mansion during the day and were imprisoned at night.

Two years later, Yefeng's identity changed from the daughter of the prefect to a servant serving night fragrance in the Meng Mansion. She worked hard with the dirty smell all day long. When she returned to the prison at night, she had no time to relax.

Aunt Zhang, who is elderly, has been getting worse and worse ever since she was imprisoned without enough food and clothing. After Yefeng asked the prison chief to guard her, she has been resting in the prison to recuperate.But no one knew that Aunt Zhang, who lay in the two-person cell all day long, would lie next to the wall and dig holes with silver hairpins during the day when everyone left the prison to go to work. After Yefeng returned to the cell at night, Yefeng would take over and continue digging carefully. This digging lasted for two years, and after two years, they finally found a hope.

Until Aunt Zhang became seriously ill and the money they had used to bribe the prison boss had been exhausted. Seeing that Aunt Zhang might be in danger without medicine, Yefeng gave up the idea of digging for a while longer so that the prison hole would be bigger so that the two of them could escape together.In the dead of night, after she helped Aunt Zhang to sleep, she quietly got out of the small hole that could only allow her child to pass through, and sneaked into the courtyard that used to be the prefect's old residence but is now the Meng Mansion in the dark, and went into the pharmacy to find some useful medicine.

When the sky was about to dawn, Yefeng, who had not harvested much, carried a few pieces of old ginger and a few ginseng in his arms, and secretly climbed onto the ox cart responsible for transporting night incense and left the courtyard. However, the cart was stopped on the street after a while. There were bushes of torches held high in all directions, and the street was as bright as day. Then there was the sound of an orderly army marching from far to near.
